decision: Would an at-home foam sample enable a joint purchase decision?
decision_owner: Educational case; no product owner has reviewed the study
consequence_if_wrong: Team could optimize the wrong switching condition
target: A hypothetical one-person proxy, not a sampled population

baseline.path_y: Keep old mattress while experimenting with remedies and searching
baseline.observed_result: Costco purchase occurred; sleep improvement not established

intervention.from: no shared tactile assessment of the offered foam
intervention.to: both spouses can handle a take-home foam sample

time_context: Counterfactual period before the historic Costco purchase
assumptions: Reconstructed hypothetical behavior is not directly observed
The stated intent question is distinct from actual buying

measurement.question: Under the proposed conditions, how likely are you to attempt a mattress purchase?

design_hypothesis.product_change: Provide a small mattress material sample before ordering
design_hypothesis.critical_assumption: Jointly feeling unfamiliar foam is pivotal to commitment
design_hypothesis.predicted_behavior: An accessible physical sample could improve willingness to buy
design_hypothesis.disconfirming_observation: Couples try the sample but still refuse because returns remain hard
design_hypothesis.if_disconfirmed: Focus on seller assurance and reversibility rather than sampling
